critic_summary: Targeted failure mode: the running method's audit and falsification both run on the parent's CSVs, with no machinery to detect that a candidate's binding feature has already been removed by the champion's filter. Loop 7's streak-suppression gate had unanimous direction on the parent (every one of 11 train dates δ < 0) but fired on zero of sip-vrs-l5's submitted orders across all 11 train dates — per-date pnl tied L5 exactly, 0/5 metrics improved. This is the same redundancy-with-champion failure mode loop 3's critic warned about, now manifest. The proposed Champion-Anchored Propose-Audit-Falsify-Commit method makes three changes: (a) Step 1 reads the current champion's residual table (per-date realized_pnl) and requires every candidate in Step 2 to be tied to a named champion residual; (b) Steps 3 and 4 audit binding features and run falsification statistics on the champion's CSVs, not the parent's — the per-date δ is now (mean champion-pnl in gated bucket) minus (mean champion-pnl in not-gated bucket); (c) a new Step 5 feasibility gate requires every candidate to PASS two absolute, pre-stated thresholds — champion-trigger fraction ≥ 1% AND |champion-gated-bucket mean δ| ≥ $0.02 in the predicted direction — using numbers already computed in Steps 3 and 4. Step 6 adds a Zero-PASS branch whose explicit output is 'revert to the champion as the loop's algorithm and write a method-failure paragraph,' preventing another zero-effect loop. Gate result: 0/5 metrics improved vs running-best loop 5 (pnl tied at 1471.75, sharpe tied at 13.718, max_dd tied at -0.01637, win_rate tied at 0.35465, mean_slippage tied at 0). Action: reverted. If the new method works, the next reasoning trace will show: a champion residual table in NOTES.md, candidates each pinned to a named residual, audit/falsification numbers computed on champion CSVs, an explicit PASS/FAIL feasibility line per candidate, and a hypothesis that either fires on a non-trivial fraction of L5's orders or is honestly recorded as 'all candidates structurally redundant; revert to champion.' The 'Where I felt uncertain' section will no longer name 'champion-redundancy' as the dominant uncertainty.
